ListTagResources.description_en: Call the ListTagResources operation to query the tags attached to a resource
ListTagResources.description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询资源绑定的标签列表

OnsConsumerAccumulate.description_en: Queries the message accumulation for a specified group ID. The results include the number of stacked messages and the consumption latency
OnsConsumerAccumulate.description_zh: 查询指定Group ID的消息消费堆积情况，包括当前消息堆积数量和消费延迟时间等

OnsConsumerGetConnection.description_en: Queries the connections of clients in a specified group
OnsConsumerGetConnection.description_zh: 查询指定 Group ID 下当前客户端的连接情况

OnsConsumerResetOffset.description_en: Resets a consumer offset to a specified timestamp for a consumer group
OnsConsumerResetOffset.description_zh: 重置指定的Group ID的消费位点到指定时间戳

OnsConsumerStatus.description_en: This operation queries detailed status data for a specified group ID, including subscription relationship checks, consumption TPS statistics, load balancing status, and consumer-side connections
OnsConsumerStatus.description_zh: 查询指定Group ID详细状态数据：订阅关系检查、消费TPS统计、负载均衡状态、消费端连接

OnsConsumerTimeSpan.description_en: Queries the time range within which you can specify a point in time to reset the consumer offset for a specified topic. The time range is from the point in time when the earliest stored message was published to the topic to the point in time when the most recently stored message was published to the topic
OnsConsumerTimeSpan.description_zh: 查询Topic可重置的时间范围，即该Topic中储存的最早的和最晚的消息的生产时间

OnsDLQMessageGetById.description_en: Queries a specific dead-letter message by its message ID. The returned information includes the storage time, message body, key, and tag
OnsDLQMessageGetById.description_zh: 通过传入Message ID查询指定的死信消息。包括存储时间、消息体、Key和Tag

OnsDLQMessagePageQueryByGroupId.description_en: Queries dead-letter messages by page for a specified Group ID and time range
OnsDLQMessagePageQueryByGroupId.description_zh: 通过传入Group ID和时间段，分页查询指定时间段内该Group ID内存在的所有死信消息

OnsDLQMessageResendById.description_en: Resends a dead-letter message specified by a message ID to allow a consumer to consume the message again
OnsDLQMessageResendById.description_zh: 重发指定Message ID的死信消息，使该消息能够被Consumer再次消费

OnsGroupConsumerUpdate.description_en: Sets the message read permission for the consumer cluster that corresponds to a specified group ID. This operation is typically used to prevent a specific consumer group from reading messages
OnsGroupConsumerUpdate.description_zh: 配置指定Group ID对应的消费集群的消息读取权限。本接口一般用于禁止特定Group ID读取消息的场景

OnsGroupDelete.description_en: You can call the OnsGroupDelete operation to delete a group

OnsGroupList.description_en: Queries all Group IDs in a specified instance
OnsGroupList.description_zh: 查询指定实例下所有的Group ID信息

OnsGroupSubDetail.description_en: Queries the topics to which a group subscribes. The query fails if the consumer instances for the specified group ID are offline
OnsGroupSubDetail.description_zh: 查看Group订阅了哪些Topic，如果Group ID对应的消费者实例不在线则查不到数据

OnsInstanceBaseInfo.description_en: Queries the basic information about an instance and its endpoints for sending and receiving messages
OnsInstanceBaseInfo.description_zh: 调用OnsInstanceBaseInfo接口查询实例基本信息和收发消息的接入点

OnsInstanceCreate.description_en: Call the OnsInstanceCreate operation to create an instance

OnsInstanceDelete.description_en: Call the OnsInstanceDelete operation to delete an ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance
OnsInstanceDelete.description_zh: 调用OnsInstanceDelete接口删除云消息队列 RocketMQ 版实例

OnsInstanceInServiceList.description_en: Queries all ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ 4.x instances in a specified region
OnsInstanceInServiceList.description_zh: 查询当前账号在指定地域（Region）下所有的云消息队列 RocketMQ 版4.x实例信息

OnsInstanceUpdate.description_en: You can call the OnsInstanceUpdate operation to update the name and description of an instance
OnsInstanceUpdate.description_zh: 调用OnsInstanceUpdate接口更新实例名称和描述

OnsMessageDetail.description_en: You can call OnsMessageDetail to query the details of a specific message
OnsMessageDetail.description_zh: 调用OnsMessageDetail查询某条消息的具体信息

OnsMessageGetByKey.description_en: Performs a fuzzy query for a list of messages based on a topic and a message key
OnsMessageGetByKey.description_zh: 根据 Topic 和 Message Key 模糊查询消息信息列表

OnsMessageGetByMsgId.description_en: Queries the information about a message by specifying the message ID and determines whether the message has been consumed
OnsMessageGetByMsgId.description_zh: 通过传入 Message ID 查询指定消息的信息以及判断该指定的消息是否曾被消费过

OnsMessagePageQueryByTopic.description_en: Queries all messages that are stored in a specified topic within a specified time range by page
OnsMessagePageQueryByTopic.description_zh: 分页查询指定时间段内指定Topic内存在的所有消息

OnsMessagePush.description_en: The OnsMessagePush operation pushes a message to a specified consumer
OnsMessagePush.description_zh: 调用OnsMessagePush向指定的消费者推送消息

OnsMessageTrace.description_en: You can call the OnsMessageTrace operation to determine whether a message has been consumed based on its message ID
OnsMessageTrace.description_zh: 调用OnsMessageTrace根据Message ID来判断目标消息是否曾被消费过

OnsRegionList.description_en: Call the OnsRegionList operation to obtain a list of regions where ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ is available
OnsRegionList.description_zh: 调用OnsRegionList获取云消息队列 RocketMQ 版目前开放服务的地域（Region）信息列表

OnsTopicCreate.description_en: You can call the OnsTopicCreate operation to create a topic

OnsTopicList.description_en: Queries information about all topics in your account
OnsTopicList.description_zh: 查询账号下所有Topic的信息列表

OnsTopicStatus.description_en: Queries the total number of messages in a topic and the status of the topic
OnsTopicStatus.description_zh: 查询当前Topic下的消息总量以及Topic的状态

OnsTopicSubDetail.description_en: Queries the online consumer groups that subscribe to a specified topic
OnsTopicSubDetail.description_zh: 查看有哪些在线订阅组订阅了这个Topic

OnsTopicUpdate.description_en: Calls the OnsTopicUpdate operation to configure the read and write mode of a topic

OnsTraceGetResult.description_en: Fetches the results of a message trace query task using its task ID
OnsTraceGetResult.description_zh: 通过传入轨迹查询任务的ID获取之前的轨迹查询结果

OnsTraceQueryByMsgId.description_en: Creates a trace query task based on a topic and a message ID, and returns the task ID. You can then call the OnsTraceGetResult operation with the returned task ID to retrieve the detailed message trace
OnsTraceQueryByMsgId.description_zh: 通过传入Topic名称和Message ID创建轨迹查询任务，得到该查询任务的ID。您需要再调用OnsTraceGetResult接口，传入返回的查询任务ID，获取消息轨迹的详细结果

OnsTraceQueryByMsgKey.description_en: Creates a trace query task based on a topic name and a message key and returns the ID of the query task. You must then call the OnsTraceGetResult operation and pass the returned query task ID to retrieve the detailed results of the message trace
OnsTraceQueryByMsgKey.description_zh: 通过传入Topic名称和Message Key创建轨迹查询任务，得到该查询任务的ID。您需要再调用OnsTraceGetResult接口，传入返回的查询任务ID，获取消息轨迹的详细结果

OnsTrendGroupOutputTps.description_en: Queries the message consumption statistics for a specified group ID over a period of time
OnsTrendGroupOutputTps.description_zh: 查询指定的Group ID在一段时间内消费消息的统计信息

OnsTrendTopicInputTps.description_en: Queries the statistics about messages that are published to a topic within a period of time
OnsTrendTopicInputTps.description_zh: 查询一段时间内指定的Topic的消息写入报表数据

OpenOnsService.description_en: Invokes the OpenOnsService operation to activate the ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ service
OpenOnsService.description_zh: 调用OpenOnsService开通云消息队列 RocketMQ 版服务

UntagResources.description_en: You can call UntagResources to detach and delete tags from resources
UntagResources.description_zh: 调用UntagResources为资源解绑并删除标签
